symptoms.2: Bottles not picked up or falling during transfer to crates
symptoms.14: Pneumatic movement is weak or slow

diagnostics.remedy: Check and correct tray alignment and positioning.

diagnostics.cause: Insufficient suction or pickup mechanism problem
diagnostics.remedy: Check suction, pickup mechanism and related connections.

diagnostics.cause: Bottle guide or centering mechanism misaligned
diagnostics.remedy: Inspect and adjust the bottle guides and centering mechanism.

diagnostics.cause: Incorrect handling or damaged transfer component
diagnostics.remedy: Inspect the transfer components and correct handling/alignment.
Inspect transfer alignment and adjust the guides.

diagnostics.cause: Sensor not detecting crate or sensor contaminated
diagnostics.remedy: Check sensor condition, cleanliness and alignment.

diagnostics.cause: Safety condition, sensor signal or automatic-cycle fault
diagnostics.remedy: Check active alarms, safety conditions and sensor signals before restarting.

diagnostics.cause: Loose, misaligned or insufficiently lubricated component
diagnostics.remedy: Inspect for looseness, alignment and lubrication requirements.

diagnostics.cause: Motor, drive, electrical supply or mechanical blockage
diagnostics.remedy: Check the electrical supply, drive/motor and inspect for mechanical blockage.
Inspect guides and transfer mechanism for correct operation.
Check conveyor alignment and operating speed.
Clean, align and test the relevant sensor.

diagnostics.cause: Low air pressure, air leak or pneumatic restriction
diagnostics.remedy: Check air pressure, hoses, fittings and pneumatic components.

diagnostics.cause: Overload, poor ventilation or motor fault
diagnostics.remedy: Stop and inspect motor load, ventilation and motor condition.
Stop the equipment and safely clear the obstruction according to procedure.

diagnostics.cause: Safety interlock, alarm condition or control fault
diagnostics.remedy: Check alarms and safety interlocks before attempting restart.
Stop if unsafe and escalate to qualified maintenance personnel.
